ai_analysis.summary: The post summarizes a Fractal Data Engineer interview process reached through referral, with compensation stated as 23 LPA plus 2 L variable. It says the screening assessment covered SQL and Python; the first round covered a medium-level SQL question, PySpark code optimization, Kafka architecture, and implementation of a custom PySpark function; the second round covered project architecture, scalable ETL design, Delta Lake schema evolution, and unspecified Azure services; and the manager round covered leadership, stakeholder management, live coding of efficient ETL pipeline tests, and real-world project challenges and optimizations. The post does not provide the actual assessment questions, code, architecture details, Azure service names, or sample answers, so it identifies interview subjects but does not teach specific technical methods.
